It also sits entirely outside the candidate's research and policy interests.

jobs.title: FSSC Auditor

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to join an advisory committee, not an entry-level paid role — it requires senior standing and specialist experience the candidate does not have, and it is advisory rather than a genuine salaried position. The human-rights subject is on-mission, but the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, BMC Health Services Research
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD in a biomedical field as an essential, which the candidate does not hold and which is far outside their discipline. The health-sciences publishing focus is also well outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.reason: This is a Chief Executive role requiring an exceptional strategic leader with extensive senior organisational, financial and team-leadership experience — far beyond entry-level and disqualified on the seniority rule. The human-rights, anti-slavery mission is a perfect interest match, but the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: France Auditor Manager
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers apply: it is a Manager-level leadership role requiring significant certification/auditing experience and a Qualified Lead Auditor credential the candidate lacks, and it requires fluency in French (the candidate is only B1). The subject matter (technical certification/assurance) is also outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Vice President / Associate Director, Crisis & Risk
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — this is a senior client-facing Associate Director / VP role reporting to the Head of UK Crisis & Risk, requiring a track record of advising senior stakeholders and account/budget leadership the candidate does not have. The crisis and geopolitical-risk framing is adjacent to the candidate's interests, but the seniority is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Policy & Campaigns Officer
jobs.reason: The role's core work — evidence-based policy research, desk research, drafting briefings and legislative analysis — maps well onto the candidate's research and writing strengths and international-law grounding, and none of the essential criteria are hard blockers (no legal qualification or non-English fluency required). Human rights is a strong interest match. The main drag is that it is pitched slightly above pure entry-level (Officer with expected policy-development track record and strong UK Parliamentary/legislative knowledge the candidate would be building rather than holding), plus its UK-domestic civil-liberties focus is somewhat narrower than the candidate's international specialism.

jobs.title: SENIOR RESEARCHER/SENIOR LECTURER (AC.07.4)
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD as an essential and is a Senior Lecturer-level appointment with publication and postgraduate supervision expectations — both hard disqualifiers the candidate does not meet. The AI-in-business focus also falls outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Analyst/ Senior Analyst, Model Development Team - London
jobs.reason: This is a quantitative credit-modelling role whose essential requirements — a Master's in a quantitative discipline like Financial Engineering plus model-development experience in Excel/VBA and Python/R for statistical/cashflow modelling — are a substantial technical mismatch for the candidate's analysis-level Python and IR/law background. It is not a fit on paper, and financial credit modelling sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.
jobs.type: Contract (6-month fixed term, likely to extend)

jobs.title: Intern, Video & Photography

jobs.title: Planner Advisor
jobs.reason: Eligible on a technicality — it is entry-level, language requirements (fluent German, basic English) are met, and no disqualifier applies. But it is a scheduling/coordination and customer-service administrative role with no research or policy content and no connection to any of the candidate's interest zones, so it is a poor fit on nearly every axis.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists with a track record in the field, which the candidate (a current MSc student with RA-level experience) does not have, and it is not a concrete paid vacancy. The human-rights / securitisation subject matter is a strong interest match, but the level and nature of the posting disqualify it.

jobs.title: Head of Legal
jobs.reason: A "Head of" title is clearly beyond entry-level, and the role would require senior legal leadership and almost certainly a legal qualification the candidate lacks. Both the seniority and the qualification are hard disqualifiers.

jobs.title: Board Members
jobs.reason: A board / governance appointment is not an entry-level paid role and demands substantial senior experience and standing the candidate does not have. This is a hard level mismatch.

jobs.title: Research Manager, Capacity & Field Development
jobs.reason: The "Manager" title plus the essential requirement of a breadth of research expertise specifically in climate/environmental science applied to health places this beyond an entry-level fit and outside the candidate's domain. The role wants demonstrated project-management and portfolio experience in a scientific funding context the candidate does not have, and the climate-health science subject is well outside the candidate's international-law and security focus.

jobs.title: Assistant Editor
jobs.reason: The role requires an essential STEM subject-matter expertise (Medicine / Life / Physical Science / Engineering) and a Master's in those fields, which the candidate — an IR / politics specialist — plainly lacks. It is also outside all three interest zones, being a science-publishing editorial-operations post.

jobs.title: Student Administration Officer
jobs.reason: This is an administrative processing role (fees, funding applications, student records) rather than a research or analysis post; the candidate's higher-education administration background at the German Rectors' Conference gives partial paper fit, but the work is transactional and offers little of the research/writing the candidate is strongest in. Higher-education administration sits outside the core interest zones, and while eligible and entry-adjacent, the fit is weak on both skills-utilisation and interest.

Despite the Verisk Maplecroft name, the property-catastrophe insurance focus and commercial product-management skillset are a clear mismatch with the candidate's research profile and interest zones.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Adviser

jobs.title: Advisory Board Member
jobs.reason: An advisory board role requires senior standing and typically decades of expertise, well beyond an early-career candidate. The mission fits, but the seniority is a hard mismatch.
